The Section Name Prefix <snp> shall be the module ab- breviation (in uppercase letters) of the BSW module derived from the BswMod- uleDescription 's shortName if no SectionNamePrefix is defined for the BswModuleEntity implementing the related BswModuleEntry .

The Section Name Prefix <snp> shall be the module ab- breviation (in uppercase letters) of the BSW module derived from the BswMod- uleDescription 's shortName if no SectionNamePrefix is defined for the BswModuleEntity implementing the related BswModuleEntry .

If no SectionNamePrefix is defined for the BswModuleEn- tity implementing the related BswModuleEntry , the Section Name Prefix <snp> shall be formed as follow: <Ma>[_<vi>_<ai>] where <Ma> is the Module abbreviation (in uppercase letters) of the BSW module derived from the BswModuleDescription 's shortName , <vi> is the vendorId (in uppercase letters) of the BSW module, and <ai> is the vendorApiInfix (in uppercase letters) of the BSW module. The sub part in squared brackets [_<vi>_<ai>] is omitted if no vendorApiInfix is defined for the Basic Software Module .

If no SectionNamePrefix is defined for the BswModuleEn- tity implementing the related BswModuleEntry , the Section Name Prefix <snp> shall be formed as follow: <Ma>[_<vi>_<ai>] where <Ma> is the Module abbreviation (in uppercase letters) of the BSW module derived from the BswModuleDescription 's shortName , <vi> is the vendorId (in uppercase letters) of the BSW module, and <ai> is the vendorApiInfix (in uppercase letters) of the BSW module. The sub part in squared brackets [_<vi>_<ai>] is omitted if no vendorApiInfix is defined for the Basic Software Module .
